Download Naruto Senki Mod Apk version 2.1.6 with all ninjas unlocked and other game modes unlocked too. 

Naruto Senki Mod is an animated fighting game in which you fight from stage to stage, using your powers to fight powerful opponents. 

When playing the game you can choose between five skills buttons that gives you different powers to charge against your opponents. 

There are different game modes available within the games such as 1v1, 3v3, Story mode, boss, clone, Shogi, Training. 

Settings options in Naruto Shippuden Senki Mod also allows you to adjust volume, use experimental option, change game language, check for game updates and more. 

Characters available in Naruto Senki Mod are Uzumaki Naruto, Haruno Sakura, Sai, Hatake Kakashi, Nara Shikamaru, Yamanaka Into, Akimichi Choji and more. 

Download Naruto Shippuden Senki Mod Apk For Android 

Once you download the latest version or edition of Naruto Senki Mod, just locate the downloaded Apk app in your downloads folder, then click to start the installation process.
